appearances.whereabouts: arrives at the inn in Emond's Field, performs on the Green

appearances.demeanor: irritable and imperious initially, then theatrical and performative, wary and uncomfortable around Moiraine
alliances_shown: shows discomfort around Moiraine and Lan

appearances.whereabouts: on the Green near the inn, then travels back to the farm with Tam
appearances.notable_actions: watches the gleeman perform; discusses the black rider with Mat and Perrin; plans to tell the Mayor tomorrow; travels home with Tam while keeping watch
appearances.demeanor: excited about the gleeman but anxious about the black rider; relieved when Tam believes him

appearances.whereabouts: on the Green near the inn
appearances.notable_actions: watches the gleeman with excitement; asks for tales of Lenn and Salya; agrees to assist Thom in his performance; defends Padan Fain briefly; follows Nynaeve when she leaves
appearances.demeanor: excited and delighted by the gleeman, torn between defending Nynaeve and enjoying the performance

appearances.whereabouts: on the Green near the inn
appearances.notable_actions: watches the gleeman; asks about the war and battles; volunteers for the patrols; plans to find witnesses who saw the black rider
appearances.demeanor: eager and excited about adventure, disappointed the war won't reach them, enthusiastic about joining patrols

appearances.whereabouts: on the Green near the inn

appearances.whereabouts: at the inn with the Village Council, then travels home with Rand

appearances.demeanor: thoughtful and measured, patient in explaining Council decisions, protective of Rand
